intent: Admit two restriction-only helpers required by the immutable module line-budget: extract Orchestrator._execute_task control flow and operation ordering into a sub-1000-line import-leaf async helper while retaining a thin same-signature Orchestrator method that passes the host logger explicitly, and isolate the closed SADHANA provider carrier, exact route validation, and exact trusted-origin Ollama invocation in a sub-1000-line provider guard. This admission changes no intended runtime behavior, grants no authority, and admits no ceiling waiver.

commit.message: governance: admit SADHANA pre-effect module split

dharmagraph_provides: one import-leaf orchestrator_execution.execute_task helper behind the existing same-signature Orchestrator._execute_task method
one restriction-only campaign provider guard with exact carrier, route, origin, logical-model, and wire-model checks
organism_provides: typed campaign authority and control-generation fence
sole-writer dispatch serialization and durable recovery evidence
cross_packet_interface.shared_proof: the structural split changes neither lifecycle ordering nor provider eligibility while keeping all touched production modules within their immutable line ceilings

interface_mismatches: Orchestrator is already exactly at its immutable 3215-line grandfather ceiling before the required campaign pre-effect handshake.
Providers has only 44 lines of remaining grandfather headroom, less than the closed carrier, trusted-origin, and exact-model proof surface.
The line-budget evaluator grades committed objects, so a green dirty-worktree invocation is not evidence that the final implementation fits.
honest_blockers: Admission performs no provider, verifier, task, lease, process, transport, deployment, or external-world effect.
The async helper is a structural extraction only; it must not reorder lifecycle, recovery, scheduling, or provider-boundary operations.
The helper must never import Orchestrator, and the host wrapper must pass dharma_swarm.orchestrator.logger as one explicit keyword-only dependency at invocation time.
Orchestrator constructor, class module, MRO, public method signature, and monkeypatch target remain unchanged.
Traceback, source-file, and helper qualname frames necessarily name dharma_swarm.orchestrator_execution after extraction; no bytecode or frame-identity equivalence is claimed.
The provider guard is restriction-only and cannot create campaign authority or make a generic provider exact.
No module ceiling, secret scan, test gate, or history gate is waived or weakened.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the later eight-file implementation and this admission. Keep campaign dispatch disabled until the prior generic modules are restored without exceeding immutable ceilings; preserve all durable state and external evidence.
